approval.approved_scope: Full plan in director-treatment.md (all 35 beats) approved by the creator on 2026-11-14/15, including real brand logos (LinkedIn, Indeed, HiringCafe, Claude, Google Sheets) and YouTube-style subscribe / like / share buttons in theme colours. Execution notes: b30 is classified FULLSCREEN_MOTION (footage blurs in place); ChatGPT icon added because the narration names it.

beats.spoken_text: AI just killed LinkedIn and Indeed.
beats.purpose: Cross out both big boards on the hook line
beats.rationale: One short phrase whose timing is the effect; presenter untouched.

beats.spoken_text: There's a free site that is 10x better than both and almost nobody knows about it.
beats.purpose: Land the 10x claim beside the presenter
beats.rationale: One short phrase whose timing is the effect; presenter untouched.

beats.spoken_text: It is called HiringCafe, hiringcafe.com. It is free. You don't even need an account.
beats.purpose: Name the site, its address and the two promises
beats.rationale: Small supporting element in a side margin (camera) or inside the framed screen; presenter face clear.

beats.spoken_text: You're fighting hundreds of people for the same job. Your applicant number 400. Nobody is reading number 400.
beats.purpose: Make applicant 400 feel hopeless
beats.rationale: One short phrase whose timing is the effect; presenter untouched.

beats.spoken_text: A job doesn't start on LinkedIn. It starts on the company's own careers page... three times a day.

beats.rationale: Process or comparison that needs the whole canvas; narration continues underneath.

beats.spoken_text: You see the job before it shows up on LinkedIn and you apply before the crowd. You are early.

beats.rationale: One short phrase whose timing is the effect; presenter untouched.

beats.spoken_text: The big job boards only show you 20% of the jobs companies pay to promote. The other 80% are here.
